questions.text: Can a deterministic, standard-library-only oracle distinguish direct dependency readiness from depth-wave scheduling across declaration permutations and repeated fan-out/fan-in?
questions.possible_graph_change: May split topology and lifecycle fixtures so one oracle does not accidentally encode the runtime's own ordering.

questions.text: Which crash boundaries can be asserted without claiming exactly-once execution or native-handle reconnection?
questions.possible_graph_change: May add separate simulated protocol tests and a bounded live experiment rather than treating either as proof of the other.

questions.text: Does the shared-workspace disjoint-output declaration prevent undeclared writes, or only make their absence an attestation?
questions.possible_graph_change: May leave concurrent code/source mutation out of scope and require a future isolation design before widening concurrency.

questions.text: How can a host prove it used the currently selected Backchain and Until Loop cards without turning semantic convergence into a generic kernel prerequisite?
questions.possible_graph_change: May add a host-side companion audit helper and forged-evidence negatives while retaining structural accept-plan behavior.

questions.text: Which experiment outcomes would justify a future multi-host, per-agent-worktree, or concurrent-command design?
questions.possible_graph_change: May record those designs as deferred decisions because the current local POSIX run scope cannot establish them.

resolved_facts: The v2 frontier admits only concurrent agent actions and retains commands, prompts, and planning as global exclusive owners.
A terminal success requires every workflow step to have an accepted receipt and no active action.
The current kernel accepts structural Backchain packaging and bindings; it does not inspect a semantic planning companion.
The selected Backchain 0.3.4 compatibility-native route delegates recurrence and terminal authority to the selected Until Loop adapter rather than using a Backchain pass counter.
The selected Until Loop ephemeral adapter removes state at terminal transition, so its exact terminal stdout must be retained outside the temporary state file.
assumptions: A deterministic generated-DAG oracle will expose readiness or terminal-state regressions that hand-authored shapes miss.
A local crash-cut simulation can establish protocol behavior for the tested process boundaries but cannot establish exactly-once external effects.
A cooperative declared-output lease is insufficient evidence that an agent made no undeclared shared-workspace change.
A companion audit can verify recorded identity and receipt consistency without making semantic convergence a kernel-enforced policy.
